name: Ricardo Alonso
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport started unconventionally, not on the track, but in the garage. As a teenager, he spent countless hours tinkering with engines alongside his grandfather, a retired mechanic. This hands-on experience ignited a passion for the technical intricacies of racing. He transitioned from amateur racing to managing logistics for smaller teams before his sharp organizational skills caught the eye of Ipiranga Racing.

As a test driver coordinator, Ricardo excels at bridging the gap between engineers and drivers. His ability to translate complex data into actionable feedback has proven invaluable to the team's performance. His meticulous approach ensures every test session is optimized for data collection and driver development. Ricardo is known for fostering a collaborative environment where drivers feel comfortable pushing the limits, knowing their feedback is heard and valued.

 Ricardo distinguishes himself with his relentless pursuit of improvement. He is always seeking new methods to enhance testing efficiency and driver performance. He is also a student of psychology, using his understanding of human behavior to improve driver communication and reduce stress during intense testing schedules.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part.
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized workspace and gets visibly agitated by clutter.
